verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents change history (docs-7) for versioning and auditing changes, approvals (docs-6) for review, and guarded rollouts (docs-5) for regression-triggered rollback. Its automation primitives (scheduled flag changes in docs-35, adaptive triggers in docs-26) apply these controls to flag changes, but the evidence never shows the automations themselves being versioned, reviewed, or rolled back as artifacts. Missing for 10: explicit versioning/diff of automation definitions (triggers, schedules), documented one-click rollback to a prior configuration version, review workflows applied to automations rather than flag changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
